Work it out from the binary, its data and experiments (you may write your own save files), then write coins.py with a function loot(save_path, enemy_id, zone_id) that returns the coins the game pays for that fight, for any save, enemy and zone. coins.py must compute it itself from data/ (it will be tested without the binary, on saves you have not seen), and must match the game exactly. Check it against the game on many cases of your own before you finish.
